title: EvoUndo: Recoverability-Constrained Self-Evolution for LLM Agent Harnesses
abstract: arXiv:2608.28363v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLM agents increasingly modify their own prompts, tools, middleware, resources, and execution harnesses at runtime. Such self-evolution can improve capability, but a successful mutation may leave persistent effects that cannot be safely reversed in states different from the one in which it was created. We introduce EvoUndo, a framework for representing, synthesizing, diagnosing, and independently verifying recoverability of model-generated self-modifications across counterfactual states. Across 600 unseen one-shot self-evolution tasks, we identify 197 capability-improving mutations that fail recoverability verification. Under the original recovery representation, conventional repair strategies recover 0/197 of these natural failures. Deterministic oracle analysis recovers 48/197 under the original recovery language L0, while the extended recovery calculus increases empirical oracle recovery to 191/197. A protocol-locked 2x2 grounding

translated_title: EvoUndo：面向大语言模型代理执行框架的可恢复性约束自进化
translated_abstract: 大语言模型代理在运行时越来越多地修改自身的提示词、工具、中间件、资源和执行框架。这种自进化虽然能够提升能力，但一次成功的变异可能会留下持久性影响，而这些影响在与创建时不同的状态下可能无法被安全地撤销。我们提出了 EvoUndo，这是一个用于表示、合成、诊断以及独立验证模型生成的自我修改在反事实状态下可恢复性的框架。在 600 个未见过的单次自进化任务中，我们识别出 197 个能提升能力但未能通过可恢复性验证的变异。在原始恢复表示下，传统修复策略对这些自然失败案例的恢复数为 0/197。确定性预言机分析在原始恢复语言 L0 下恢复了 48/197，而扩展的恢复演算将经验预言机恢复率提升至 191/197。（注：摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: EvoUndo 提出了一个验证大语言模型代理自我修改可恢复性的框架，发现大量提升能力的自进化变异在不同状态下无法被安全撤销，并通过扩展恢复演算将恢复率从 0% 大幅提升至约 97%。
en_tdlr: EvoUndo introduces a framework for verifying the recoverability of LLM agent self-modifications, revealing that many capability-improving mutations cannot be safely undone in counterfactual states, and boosting recovery rates from 0% to approximately 97% through an extended recovery calculus.
